reviewer: Codex source adjudication for founder-requested GameStop recovery
adjudication: This additive scope identifies English Lechonk 154/198 with the red GameStop stamp and Reverse Holo finish. Unstamped cards and other retailer stamps are separate identities outside this scope.
source_independence: Two evidence families: PokeBeach original editorial release reporting and the exact merchant product/image. Merchant page and image count as one vote; mirrored editorial descriptions add no vote.
